assumptions.target_condition: spread_mid + exit_slippage <= target; persistence executes at final confirmation minute
assumptions.next_minute: Exactly 60 seconds after first executable touch; absent next minute falls back to terminal proxy and is flagged.
assumptions.drawdown: Realized trade P/L in entry chronological order within each separate family, not a portfolio mark-to-market drawdown.
assumptions.terminal: Last synchronized quote through expiration 16:00 ET; NOT settlement; no settlement data verified.
assumptions.underwater: Observed consecutive 60-second intervals above entry midpoint; overnight and gaps excluded.
assumptions.anatomy: Development only, midpoint $3 touch; clean means max debit <= entry midpoint + $0.50 before success. Adverse-then-success exceeds that level. Severe excursion ($9 before $3) is also counted.
assumptions.horizons: As-of requested time, quote age <60 seconds; older observations have null value and explicit age.
assumptions.legacy: Existing evaluate helper, session-scoped input; preserves original last-quote behavior solely for reproduction.
assumptions.holdout: Unconditional prespecified execution sensitivity only; no conditional 2026 interpretation, rule selection, or validation claim.

phase3_gaps: Phase 3 local NDX/NQ/MNQ/VIX inventory and causal timestamp audit not performed (out of scope).
